answer: Agents deposit bonded stake into a vault and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose coefficients bind identity and rate limits. A Semaphore membership proof authenticates each message without exposing identity; however, duplicate use of an RLN nullifier yields two shares of the same Shamir-encoded secret, reconstructing the private key and enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. The marble and yarrow labels serve as domain-separated transcript salts.
